card.text: Explore Donaldjohanson in 3D with its published Lucy shape model.

introduction.text: Donaldjohanson is a contact-binary asteroid visited by Lucy in April 2025. Its two lobes meet at a broad neck. This archived model preserves the original scale: Lucy stereo images constrain about 40% of the surface, and the source authors reconstructed the unseen side. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery. Donaldjohanson tumbles, so its orientation and lighting here are illustrative.

llorri.title: L’LORRI encounter image
llorri.summary: Only part of the encounter-facing surface is imaged. Brightness retains original lighting; the grid marks rejected or unseen areas.

shape.title: Encounter shape model
shape.summary: Lucy's published encounter shape. The gray grid marks missing mapped imagery; lighting shows the model.
